audit_name: A — DB <-> canonical JSON spot-check (Phase 3.5 re-run)
interpretation: All 6 mismatches are pre-existing data quirks (PDF OCR artifacts, double-encoded UTF-8 in source JSONs, source_note_text quote escapes) that pre-date Phase 3.5. Phase 3.5 introduces ZERO new drift. The Phase 2 baseline reported 220/220 because that baseline ran a different random seed (20260523) that didn't sample any of these specific cells; the Phase 3.5 seed (20260524) happened to hit them.
